title: PCSS Bearing Envelope
description: The canonical age signal — produced by a Bearing Provider (typically an OS, account-level service, or third-party verifier) and consumed by Lens, Threshold, Aegis, and other PCSS runtime capabilities. See PCSS §3.

bearing_id.description: Stable, opaque identifier for this bearing envelope. MUST NOT be reused across users.

age_band.description: Coarse age band. Exact ages MUST NOT be transmitted.

confidence.description: How the age signal was established. 'attested' implies verifiable parental consent (VPC); 'inferred' implies behavioral or account signals; 'unverified' implies no positive establishment.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this envelope was issued.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp after which the envelope MUST be re-issued. Default: 30 days for unverified, 90 days for inferred, 365 days for attested.

issuer.description: Registered identifier of the Bearing Provider that issued this envelope. e.g., 'os:apple', 'os:google', 'verifier:yoti'.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 country code with optional sub-region. e.g., 'US-CA', 'EU', 'UK', 'AU'.

value.description: Base64url-encoded signature over the canonical JSON form of the envelope (with the signature object excluded).

key_id.description: Issuer's key identifier; resolves to a public key in the PCSS registry.

extensions.description: Optional implementer-specific extensions. Keys MUST carry a vendor prefix (e.g., 'apple:').
